title: Final review of the wne diff
description:
Review the epic's full diff and resolve or route every finding before close-out unblocks.

Three things specific to this epic:
  - Does anything write a MODEL NAME where a WORK TYPE belongs? The whole architecture rests on the classifier judging the work and the table judging the cost. One leak and changing the table starts invalidating recorded classifications.
  - Can a cold re-derivation from git reach a different dispatch than the warm process? That is the axiom 1 question and it is the one this epic could most plausibly get subtly wrong.
  - Is the provisional threshold labelled as provisional everywhere it appears, including in config comments? A number measured once and then treated as settled is how a starting point becomes folklore.
acceptance_criteria: Every finding is resolved or filed with an owner, and the epic's diff is confirmed against wne's definition of done item by item
